h: Group called DMI backs Tinubu's economic reforms and announces 2027 alliance
p: A group known as DMI has announced support for President Tinubu's economic reforms and declared an alliance ahead of the 2027 elections. The announcement adds to a run of endorsements as the APC campaign begins.
more: The group says the reforms need more time to deliver.
Critics say Nigerians are still struggling with the cost of living.
